notes: board: covers, outros and the board look of post cards. accent: one key word per graphic, nothing else. ink: dark type. text: body type on light slides. soft: the light slide ground. mist: light type on the board colour. deep: step numbers and arrows on light slides. on_accent: type on an accent fill. chip: the small label on covers. Fonts: a file name in studio/assets/fonts or one of the kit's fonts; the caption font must be a single static weight (reels burn it in). logo and headshot: paths in studio/assets, or null.
